Many Thanks

messages.subject: detail on gl.filter.monomorphs: Remove monomorphic loci
messages.subject_clean: detail on gl.filter.monomorphs: Remove monomorphic loci
messages.body_plain: Dear Arthur, I would like to know how the function gl.filter.monomorphs works. I understood (but perhaps I am wrong), this function removes the monomorphic loci by taking into account all the loci without paying attention to the populations.  What seems to me well, particularly in the case where the monomorphy brings a signature of differentiation to the population compared to the others.  Are there some thresholds to decide the monomorphy?  Could we set this threshold in this function?  Many thanks for your help, Have a wonderful end of day, Natacha

messages.subject: Re: detail on gl.filter.monomorphs: Remove monomorphic loci
messages.subject_clean: detail on gl.filter.monomorphs: Remove monomorphic loci
messages.body_plain:
Hi Nat,

The filter gl.filter.monomorphs is typically used to take out monomorphic loci arising when you manipulate the DArT dataset by deleting individuals or populations. The original DArT dataset should not have any monomorphic loci because the pipelines select for polymorphic loci, those containing SNPs.

The filter is also used to take out monomophic loci where these will not contribute materially to analyses, to save computational time or prevent distortion of outcomes. By default, dartR scripts retain monomophic loci. You have to explicitly request that the be removed by setting mono.rm=TRUE in the particular script, or by using gl.filter.monomorphs. Most scripts will warn you if the dataset contains monomorphic loci.

If you want to manipulate loci that are almost monomorphic, then you should use the filter for minor allele fequencies, gl.filter.maf, which has the threshold you have requested. Please look at ?gl.filter.maf.

Hope this helps.

Arthur

messages.subject: is it possible to write vcf file from dartseq data in dartR
messages.subject_clean: is it possible to write vcf file from dartseq data in dartR
messages.body_plain:
Hi
I am trying to produce dadi software input file (demographic analysis using allele frequency spectrum) import from my dart-seq data, but I cant find a way in dartR or other common popgene analysis R packages. Since dadi can read vcf format, is there a way to write  (convert) vcf file from gl, gi SNP data?
Thanks a million in advance
Farhad

by the way the input format of SNP for dadi is as below;
SNP      Allele1 n-pop1  n-pop2  n-pop3  allele2 n-pop1  n-pop2  n-pop3  Gene    Position
SNP1A/G  T     27  22  43   G   3   2   a   1
SNP2C/T  C     27  22  43   T   3   2   a   2
SNP3C/T  C     29  24  44   T   1   0   a   3
SNP4C/T  C     30  24  44   T   0   0   a   4
SNP5A/G  A     3   2   1       G   27  22  a   5

            #"n= number of times allele 1 was observed in that population"
                         # pop= population, gene and position are arbitrary columns
